regions.region: upper-right title, abstract-style introduction, and DOI
regions.finding: Article identification and general motivation only; no experiment-specific conditions or outcome are reported in this region.

regions.region: center-right Scheme 1, The hydrogenation of allenes
regions.finding: Generic R-group map of possible 1,2-hydrogenation, 2,3-hydrogenation, and complete hydrogenation products; classified as a general scheme, not a reported experiment.
The paper states that supporting information is available externally, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated in this dataset; no experiment was created from the footnote.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R groups and cannot be expanded to fully specified structures.

regions.region: upper-left catalyst drawings 1a and 1b and adjacent prior-work paragraph
regions.finding: Catalyst structures and labels used by the current study are shown; the alkyne hydrogenation described as previously reported work is contextual literature and was not imported as a new experiment.
Eleven named solvent conditions are explicitly reported as not proceeding at 20 °C; each was retained as a separate failed optimization entry with unreported catalyst/time/pressure left unresolved.

Five distinct optimization rows for 2a were extracted row-by-row, preserving solvent, catalyst, temperature, 24 h, H2 (1 atm), 0.2 mmol scale, 3 mL solvent, and yields. Entry 5 is the same 1b/THF/20 °C/94% experiment detailed on page 3 and was not duplicated.

regions.region: upper-right Table 2 and its reaction arrow/footnotes
regions.finding: Ten independent substrate-scope rows were extracted: entry 1 is no reaction with catalyst 1a; entries 2-10 use 1b and give (Z)-3b-j in reported yields under the shared THF/room-temperature/24 h/H2 (1 atm) conditions.
One experiment, 2k to (Z)-3k, was extracted at 93% yield; the text reports hydrogenation of the isolated allylic C=C bond while retaining the conjugated electron-deficient C=C bond.
Three separate arrows, 2l to (Z)-3l, 2m to (Z)-3m, and 2n to (Z)-3n, were extracted with 92%, 95%, and 85% yields under the explicitly cross-referenced Table 2 conditions.

unresolved: Yield measurement basis is not stated for Table 1 rows 1-4, Table 2 entries 2-10, or Schemes 2-3.
The eleven prose-listed failed solvent examples omit catalyst identity, time, solvent volume, substrate amount, and hydrogen pressure.
Candidate structures are unverified and product Z stereochemistry is retained in labels rather than encoded in SMILES.
Workup and purification are absent for the scope/optimization rows except the entry detailed on page 3.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 4 and lower-left mechanistic discussion
regions.finding: Proposed catalytic cycle with intermediates 5-8 and alternatives 7a/7b; classified as mechanism, not as a reported experimental transformation.

Three independent semihydrogenations were extracted: phosphine oxide 9 to 10 (68%), sulfone 11 to Z/E-12 (77%, 94:6), and allenoate 13 to Z/E-14 (80%, 94:6); the allenoate uniquely uses toluene rather than THF.

regions.region: bottom-left Experimental Section continuing at upper-right beneath Scheme 5
regions.finding: Detailed typical procedure for 2a with catalyst 1b was associated with Table 1 entry 5: catalyst/substrate masses and mmol, 3 mL anhydrous THF, N2-to-H2 atmosphere change, 20 °C for 24 h, filtration, evaporation, silica chromatography, 44 mg (94%) product.
Conclusion and analytical characterization of (Z)-3a support the already linked experiment; no additional reaction arrow or independent experiment was created.

unresolved: Scheme 5 omits reaction scale, solvent volume, yield basis, workup, and purification.
Candidate structures remain unverified; the reported E/Z identities and ratios are not encoded in the candidate SMILES.
